desc: Stash the current prompt for later. With text in the input, stashes it and clears the prompt; pressed again on an empty prompt, restores the stashed text.

Move the cursor to the end of the current line. In multiline input, moves to the end of the current logical line.
Delete back to the previous whitespace. One press removes a whole path or --flag=value.
Delete to the end of the current word, or to the end of the next word when the cursor is between words.

Compact the current conversation to keep only the important context.
Resume another conversation from inside the current session.
Rename the current conversation.

Copy the current conversation into a new background session and keep working here. Pass a prompt to start the copy on it immediately. To switch into a branch yourself, use /branch; to hand a task to a subagent that reports back, use /subtask.
Show how much context is currently in use.
Enter plan mode, optionally passing a task description to start planning immediately.

Rewind or summarize from the keyboard.
Detach the current session to run as a background agent and free your terminal. Pass a prompt to send one more instruction before detaching. Alias: /bg.
Spawn a forked subagent that inherits the full conversation and works on the task while you keep working. Its result returns to this conversation when it finishes.
Move the session to a new working directory while keeping the conversation.
Generate a one-line summary of the current session on demand.
Pull a cloud session from claude.ai into this terminal. Opens a picker, then fetches the branch and conversation. Alias: /tp.
Set the auto-compact window: how full the context window gets before Claude Code compacts automatically. Pass a size such as 500k, or auto for the model-tuned default.

Review the current diff, or a PR number, branch, or path, for correctness bugs. Pass --fix to apply findings, --comment to post them on the PR, or ultra for a deep multi-agent cloud review. Alias: /review.

Review the changed code for cleanup opportunities and apply the fixes. Four agents run in parallel covering reuse, simplification, efficiency, and abstraction level. Does not look for correctness bugs; use /code-review for those.
Confirm a code change does what it should by building the app, running it, and observing the result, rather than relying on tests or type checks.
